name: music-sync
title: Music sync
description: Finds where a music starts inside a video's sound, so a better copy of the music can replace it.

findOffset.title: Find where the music starts
findOffset.description: Tells how the music lies on a video's timeline by comparing the two sounds, however different their quality: how late it starts and, when the video runs at another speed, how much slower or faster. Give offsetMs and speed to media.replaceAudio to put a high-quality copy of the music in the video.

video.title: Video with the music in low quality
video.description: The video, or any sound, that carries the music in low quality.

music.title: Music in good quality
music.description: The music in good quality: a sound file or a video.

minScoreSigma.title: How sure the match must be
minScoreSigma.description: How far the best match over the whole length must stand out from chance. Below it the call still succeeds if three or more pieces of the music agree on a speed, and fails with 422 (no match) otherwise, so a wrong music is never put in a video.

minOverlapMs.title: Least they must share
minOverlapMs.description: The least the two sounds must share.

offsetMs.title: Music starts at
offsetMs.description: Where the music's start falls on the video's timeline, in milliseconds. Negative when the video starts partway into the music. Give it to media.replaceAudio as offsetMs.

score.title: Match strength
score.description: How far the match over the whole length stands out from chance, in standard deviations (a real copy at the same speed scores in the hundreds or more; unrelated music can reach about 15). 0 when only pieces of the music matched, as with a video at another speed.

overlapMs.title: Shared length
overlapMs.description: How much of the music lies inside the video.

speed.title: Speed of the video against the music
speed.description: How much longer the video takes than the music for the same stretch: 1 for the same speed, 1.05 when the video plays the music 5% slower. Give it to media.replaceAudio as speed, with keep to say which one keeps its speed.

piecesOnLine.title: Pieces that agreed
piecesOnLine.description: How many pieces of the music agreed on the speed; null when too few were found to tell (the speed is then 1).

failures.description: A param is wrong or video or music is missing.
A sound is longer than 30 minutes.
No match (not the same music), the sounds are silent, or a file is not a sound this plugin can read.
